joining.title: How to Join
joining.visitorTitle: Visiting or New to the Club
joining.visitorNote: You can paddle with the club up to 3 times before submitting the 9th Island OCC Membership Application and registering with SCORA. The SCORA waiver must be filled out as soon as possible.
joining.stepsTitle: All new and returning members must complete:

steps.name: Register with SCORA
steps.detail: New paddlers only. If you registered with SCORA in previous years, reuse your existing SCORA number.

steps.name: SCORA Liability Waiver (SmartWaiver)
steps.detail: Required every season, for members and visitors alike.

joining.duesIntro: 9th Island OCC offers two ways to pay your annual dues:

duesOptions.detail: Payable to 9th Island Outrigger. Please provide your check(s) to Hannah Murphy.
Send to 702-994-3651. It will show as Jim Taylor, 9th Island Outrigger.

joining.questionsNote: If you have any questions, please email Hannah.
